description: List the resource providers this server can provision from, such as a PostgreSQL database or an AI model: what each one is for, its plans, the first being the default, the environment variables an attachment sets, and a guide to using it from an app. Read it when choosing a resource and writing the app code that uses one. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to list for. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_catalog_resources

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call resolved to; attach_resource lands in it. Empty when the server has no resource provider.

providers.description: The providers this server can provision a resource from. Empty when it has none.

description.description: What the resource is and when an app needs one.

display_name.description: The provider's name for a person to read.

env_vars.description: Names of the environment variables an attachment sets, before any env_prefix.

guide.description: Markdown on how an app uses the resource once attached.

name.description: The provider's name. Pass it as provider to attach_resource.

plans.description: The provider's plans in its order. The first is what attach_resource provisions when no plan is named.

display_name.description: The plan's name for a person to read.

name.description: The plan's name. Pass it as plan to attach_resource.

title: List catalog resource providers
